017package org.apache.juneau.console.widgets;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.util.*;
022
023import org.apache.juneau.commons.bean.*;
024
025/**
026 * The declarative modal (dialog) a {@code present=dialog} row action opens &mdash; the payload the
027 * <b>modal-open confirmation fetch</b> returns.
028 *
029 * <h2 class='section'>A widget contract driven by a view-module runtime</h2>
030 * <p>
031 * This bean is a general widget contract and lives in this module, but the browser runtime that paints it ships with
032 * the rich-view module (it is part of that module's {@code juneau-views.js} monolith, which is not split apart here).
033 * So a page that opens one of these dialogs loads the view runtime; nothing in this module reaches back to it.
034 *
035 * <h2 class='section'>Safe-by-construction confirmation body</h2>
036 * <p>
037 * The confirmation body is <b>typed structured fields</b> ({@link #fields}: incident #, title, service, current
038 * status &mdash; the confirmation field set), server-rendered against the current, authoritative record and
039 * bound to the target identifier.  The {@code juneau-views.js} runtime paints each field's value with
040 * {@code textContent} &mdash; NEVER {@code innerHTML}, never raw markup, never the non-table panel-content sink.
041 * Live/remote data is attacker-influenceable (anyone who can title an incident or post in a watched thread) and this
042 * origin holds the CSRF token, so an HTML sink here would be stored-XSS&nbsp;&rarr;&nbsp;token-theft&nbsp;&rarr;
043 * arbitrary-write; typed fields painted with {@code textContent} close that off by construction.
044 *
045 * <h2 class='section'>The idempotency key rides here</h2>
046 * <p>
047 * {@link #idempotencyKey} is a server-minted key value, minted at modal-open and bound to
048 * {@code (action, targetId)}.  The runtime carries it verbatim on the submit so a double-click / re-submit / browser
049 * retry all collapse to one effect; the server checks that binding on submit and answers a mismatch with a named
050 * refusal, never a replayed success.  The minting/binding helper itself is a table-and-row-action concern and stays
051 * in the rich-view module, which is why this field is a plain {@code String} rather than that helper's type.
052 *
053 * <h2 class='section'>{@link #selfTargeted} &mdash; the opt-in for a key that targets itself</h2>
054 * <p>
055 * A dialog opened where there is <b>no row</b> (a ribbon-hosted dialog whose submit creates the thing it is about)
056 * has no artifact id to bind its key to at modal-open.  The rich-view module's key helper can mint a key whose
057 * bound target <i>is its own value</i>; {@link #selfTargeted} is the signal that tells the runtime to send that
058 * value as the submitted target instead of the row's id.
059 * <p>
060 * The signal has to ride on this bean, because it cannot be inferred from the wire: {@link #idempotencyKey} is an
061 * opaque string either way, indistinguishable in shape from an artifact-bound key's value.  It is therefore an
062 * explicit, additive, per-dialog opt-in &mdash; <b>not</b> a blanket runtime precedence rule.  A dialog that leaves
063 * this unset behaves exactly as it does today, <i>including</i> one that sets {@link #idempotencyKey} for an
064 * artifact-bound reason: it keeps sending the row's real id, which is what its own mint call bound.
065 * <p>
066 * Set it <b>only</b> on a modal whose key came from the self-targeted mint helper.  Setting it on a modal carrying
067 * an artifact-bound key silently discards the real target and makes the server's binding check vacuous.
068 *
069 * <h2 class='section'>{@link #keepOpenOnSubmit} &mdash; the opt-in for an in-dialog result receipt</h2>
070 * <p>
071 * By default the runtime closes a dialog at confirm-click time and then submits, so every dialog is gone before its
072 * result exists.  {@link #keepOpenOnSubmit} suppresses that close, and the runtime instead paints the write's
073 * <b>result</b> into the dialog that is already open &mdash; a <i>receipt</i>.
074 * <p>
075 * A receipt host is <b>non-submittable by construction</b>, not by convention: the runtime paints it with a distinct
076 * function that creates no confirm control at all, and it refuses to paint one whose payload carries a
077 * {@link #form}.  It is reached <b>only</b> after a committed write (an
078 * {@code ActionResult} whose outcome is {@code success}), so a result host can never appear for a write that did not
079 * happen.  A follow-up read-only form source is named by that result's {@code resultForm}.
080 * <p>
081 * The opt-in has to live here rather than on the action bean, because the confirm handler must decide whether to
082 * close <i>before</i> any response exists.  A dialog synthesized from a {@code confirm} string alone (no form-source
083 * URL) therefore cannot opt in &mdash; a receipt-bearing action must serve a real {@link ModalDef}.
084 * <p>
085 * Additive, and named degradation, accepted: an older runtime ignoring this flag closes the dialog and drops the
086 * receipt.  The write still happens; the receipt is simply not shown.
087 *
088 * <h2 class='section'>{@link #childActions} &mdash; the dialog-scoped child-action catalog</h2>
089 * <p>
090 * A {@code type="action"} form input names an action id, and the runtime resolves it against the enclosing view's
091 * row-action catalog.  A <b>stacked</b> step reached from inside an already-open dialog (a Review step in a wizard)
092 * has nothing legal to resolve against there: it is not a row action, and publishing it as one would surface it in
093 * every row's action menu.  {@link #childActions} is that missing catalog, scoped to <b>one open dialog</b>.
094 * <p>
095 * Scoping is <b>structural</b>, not a flag some menu builder has to remember to filter on: this catalog rides on a
096 * per-open payload, so the row-action menu and the ribbon resolver never see it and there is no exclusion logic to
097 * rot.  Resolution precedence is likewise fail-safe: the existing row-action check runs <b>first</b> and unchanged,
098 * so a served payload can never shadow &mdash; and thereby bypass the gating of &mdash; a declared row action.
099 *
100 * <h2 class='section'>{@link #chrome} and {@link #steps} &mdash; dialog styling and a built-in wizard</h2>
101 * <p>
102 * {@link #chrome} names a dialog chrome the page script registered with the runtime; the runtime hands that chrome the
103 * freshly built dialog parts so it can restyle them.  An unregistered name is ignored and the default chrome is kept.
104 * <p>
105 * {@link #steps} turns the dialog into a wizard: the runtime shows one {@link Step} at a time with Back and Next
106 * buttons, and the last step's button is the dialog's own confirm.  Both are additive-only and omitted from the wire
107 * when unset, so neither bumps {@link #CONTRACT_VERSION}.
108 *
109 * <h2 class='section'>{@link #nav} &mdash; the inner-navigation style</h2>
110 * <p>
111 * {@link #nav} picks how the runtime draws the section strip of a {@link FormDef#sections sectioned} form:
112 * {@link #NAV_PILL} (the default) or {@link #NAV_FOLDER} (square-topped folder tabs).  A wizard needs no value here:
113 * {@link #steps} alone makes the dialog a wizard, and the runtime then draws a numbered step indicator instead of a
114 * strip.  {@link #validate()} rejects any other value; the runtime still treats an unknown one as {@link #NAV_PILL}.
115 * Additive-only and omitted from the wire when unset, so it does not bump {@link #CONTRACT_VERSION}.
116 *
117 * <h2 class='section'>Not a new row-action wire field</h2>
118 * <p>
119 * This is the response a row action's form-source URL returns, <b>not</b> a new field on the frozen row-action wire
120 * schema: the modal's declaration lives in this separately-served payload so the row-action contract stays frozen.
121 * The same reasoning is why {@link #keepOpenOnSubmit} and {@link #childActions} land here rather than on
122 * {@code RowAction} / {@code RibbonAction}, which stay frozen and untouched.
123 *
124 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
125 * <p class='bjava'>
126 *    ModalDef <jv>modal</jv> = ModalDef.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"Acknowledge this incident?"</js>)
127 *       .field(<js>"Incident"</js>, <jv>incidentNumber</jv>)
128 *       .field(<js>"Title"</js>, <jv>incidentTitle</jv>)
129 *       .field(<js>"Service"</js>, <jv>serviceName</jv>)
130 *       .field(<js>"Current status"</js>, <jv>currentStatus</jv>)
131 *       .form(FormDef.<jsm>ofTemplate</jsm>(<js>"servlet:/incidents/ack-form.ftl"</js>))
132 *       .idempotencyKey(<jv>keyValue</jv>);
133 * </p>
134 *
135 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2>
136 * <ul>
137 *    <li class='jc'>{@link FormDef}
138 *    <li class='jc'>{@link Widget}
139 * </ul>
140 *
141 * <h2 class='section'>The third named bar-slot host</h2>
142 * <p>
143 * {@link #barSlot} is the <i>third</i> named {@link BarSlot} attachment &mdash; alongside the rich-view module's page
144 * and row-detail hosts (that module never depends on this one, so they are not linked here).  Unlike those two
145 * &mdash; Java-only fields a server-side emitter paints directly, omitted from their wire &mdash; this modal itself
146 * <b>is</b> the wire payload the modal-open confirmation fetch returns, with no separate server-rendered pass the
147 * dialog could ride into.  So this field <b>is</b> carried on the wire (additive-only: {@code null} when unset, and
148 * its presence does not bump {@link #CONTRACT_VERSION}), and the {@code juneau-views.js} runtime paints the region
149 * and its dynamic-count sidecar client-side from the JSON, the same way it already paints typed confirmation
150 * {@link #fields} and {@link #form} controls &mdash; {@code textContent} only, never {@code innerHTML}.  The dialog
151 * anchors its own region immediately after the title (the {@code ANCHOR_DIALOG_TITLE}
152 * placement in {@code juneau-views.js}), owning that placement itself rather than leaning on the shared strip builder,
153 * exactly as the row-detail host owns its own ribbon-trailing relocation.
154 *
155 * @since 10.0.0
156 */
157@BeanType(properties="contractVersion,title,fields,form,idempotencyKey,selfTargeted,barSlot,keepOpenOnSubmit,childActions,chrome,steps,nav")
158@SuppressWarnings({
159   "java:S1845", // Fluent-builder setters intentionally mirror field names (Juneau DSL convention).
160   "java:S3776" // Branching is inherent to validate() and validateChildActions(), which check many field/child-action combinations.
161})
162public class ModalDef implements Widget {
163
164   /**
165    * The frozen modal contract version.  Bumped only on a breaking wire change to this modal contract.
166    *
167    * <p>
168    * Moves in <b>lockstep</b> with {@link FormDef#CONTRACT_VERSION} and the runtime's baked-in literal: the runtime
169    * compares one literal against both this version and the nested form's, so bumping any two of the three makes
170    * every form-bearing dialog refuse to open.
171    */
172   public static final String CONTRACT_VERSION = "2";
173
174   /** The {@link Field#kind} token for an ordinary text value &mdash; the default when the field declares none. */
175   public static final String FIELD_KIND_TEXT = "text";
176
177   /** The {@link Field#kind} token for a monospaced, copyable value (an id, a URL, a generated token). */
178   public static final String FIELD_KIND_CODE = "code";
179
180   /** The {@link #nav} token for the default rounded section strip. */
181   public static final String NAV_PILL = "pill";
182
183   /** The {@link #nav} token for square-topped folder tabs over a bottom rule. */
184   public static final String NAV_FOLDER = "folder";
185
186   /**
187    * A single typed confirmation field: a label and a value, painted client-side with {@code textContent} (never
188    * {@code innerHTML}).
189    *
190    * @since 10.0.0
191    */
192   @BeanType(properties="label,value,kind")
193   public static class Field {
194
195      /** The field label shown to the user. */
196      public String label;
197
198      /** The field value, read back from the current authoritative record. */
199      public String value;
200
201      /**
202       * How this field's value is <i>displayed</i>; omitted from the wire when unset (which reads as
203       * {@link ModalDef#FIELD_KIND_TEXT text}).
204       *
205       * <p>
206       * The allowlist is exactly {@link ModalDef#FIELD_KIND_TEXT text} and {@link ModalDef#FIELD_KIND_CODE code};
207       * {@link ModalDef#validate()} rejects anything else server-side, and the runtime falls back to
208       * {@code text} for an unrecognized token rather than trusting it.
209       *
210       * <p>
211       * This is a <b>display</b> kind on a confirmation field, deliberately <b>not</b> a new
212       * {@code FormDef.Input} type: a {@code code} field carries no submit value, so expressing it as an input
213       * would mean teaching the collection, validation, prefill and submit paths about a control that is not one.
214       */
215      public String kind;
216
217      /**
218       * Creates a typed confirmation field.
219       *
220       * @param label The field label.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
221       * @param value The field value.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (rendered as an empty value).
222       * @return A new {@link Field}.
223       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code label} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
224       */
225      public static Field of(String label, String value) {
226         if (ib(label))
227            throw iaex("ModalDef.Field label must not be null or blank.");
228         var f = new Field();
229         f.label = label;
230         f.value = value;
231         return f;
232      }
233
234      /**
235       * Creates a typed confirmation field displayed as monospaced, copyable {@link ModalDef#FIELD_KIND_CODE code}.
236       *
237       * <p>
238       * The runtime paints the value into a {@code <pre>} with {@code textContent} (never {@code innerHTML}) and
239       * adds a copy button that is feature-detected and never throws; the {@code <pre>} stays selectable, so
240       * manual copy always works.
241       *
242       * @param label The field label.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
243       * @param value The field value.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (rendered as an empty value).
244       * @return A new {@link Field}.
245       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code label} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
246       */
247      public static Field code(String label, String value) {
248         var f = of(label, value);
249         f.kind = FIELD_KIND_CODE;
250         return f;
251      }
252   }
253
254   /**
255    * One page of a {@link ModalDef#steps} wizard: an id, an optional title and confirm-button label, and the typed
256    * display fields painted for that page.
257    *
258    * @since 10.0.0
259    */
260   @BeanType(properties="id,title,confirmLabel,fields")
261   public static class Step {
262
263      /** The step id, unique within the modal; a script selects a step by it.  Must not be blank. */
264      public String id;
265
266      /** The dialog title shown while this step is current; omitted from the wire when unset (the modal title stays). */
267      public String title;
268
269      /** The confirm-button label for this step; omitted when unset (the runtime shows Next; on the last step it shows the dialog's confirm label, else Finish). */
270      public String confirmLabel;
271
272      /** The typed display fields painted for this step, in display order; omitted from the wire when none are declared. */
273      public List<Field> fields;
274
275      /**
276       * Creates a step.
277       *
278       * @param id The step id.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
279       * @return A new {@link Step}.
280       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code id} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
281       */
282      public static Step of(String id) {
283         if (ib(id))
284            throw iaex("ModalDef.Step id must not be null or blank.");
285         var s = new Step();
286         s.id = id;
287         return s;
288      }
289
290      /**
291       * Sets the dialog title shown while this step is current.
292       *
293       * @param value The title.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset.
294       * @return This object.
295       */
296      public Step title(String value) {
297         title = value;
298         return this;
299      }
300
301      /**
302       * Sets the confirm-button label for this step.
303       *
304       * @param value The label.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset.
305       * @return This object.
306       */
307      public Step confirmLabel(String value) {
308         confirmLabel = value;
309         return this;
310      }
311
312      /**
313       * Adds one typed display field to this step.
314       *
315       * @param label The field label.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
316       * @param value The field value.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.
317       * @return This object.
318       */
319      public Step field(String label, String value) {
320         if (fields == null)
321            fields = l();
322         fields.add(Field.of(label, value));
323         return this;
324      }
325   }
326
327   /**
328    * One entry in a dialog's {@link ModalDef#childActions} catalog &mdash; a stacked step a {@code type="action"}
329    * input inside <i>this</i> dialog's form may open.
330    *
331    * <h2 class='section'>Dialog-presenting by construction</h2>
332    * <p>
333    * A child action carries no {@code present} field: opening a stacked dialog is the only thing it does.  A child
334    * with no {@link #form} is a legal confirm-only child dialog.
335    *
336    * <h2 class='section'>No gating vocabulary, on purpose</h2>
337    * <p>
338    * There is deliberately no {@code enabledWhen} here, for three independent reasons.  The rule type lives in the
339    * rich-view module, which this module must not reference.  A dialog opened where there is no row has no row data
340    * to evaluate against, so a field-keyed rule would fail closed forever with no signal to its author.  And the
341    * subject of a child step is the <i>draft in the open dialog</i>, not the parent row &mdash; so evaluating the
342    * parent row's data would answer a question nobody asked.  Gating a child step is the <b>server's</b> job at
343    * child-form-GET time; it already owns that GET and can refuse it.
344    *
345    * @since 10.0.0
346    */
347   @BeanType(properties="id,label,form,endpoint,method,onSuccess,carryDrafts")
348   public static class ChildAction {
349
350      /** The action id a {@code type="action"} input in this dialog's form names.  Required, non-blank. */
351      public String id;
352
353      /** The label painted on the button that opens this child.  Required, non-blank. */
354      public String label;
355
356      /**
357       * The child dialog's read-only form-source URL; omitted from the wire when unset (a confirm-only child).
358       *
359       * <p>
360       * Required if this child declares {@link #carryDrafts} &mdash; with no URL there is nothing for the draft
361       * query to ride on, so the drafts would vanish silently.
362       */
363      public String form;
364
365      /** The child's submit endpoint; omitted from the wire when unset.  See {@link #endpoint(String)}. */
366      public String endpoint;
367
368      /** The child's submit method; omitted from the wire when unset.  See {@link #method(String)}. */
369      public String method;
370
371      /** The child's on-success behaviour token; omitted from the wire when unset. */
372      public String onSuccess;
373
374      /**
375       * Whether opening this child carries the <b>parent dialog's current draft values</b> to its form-source GET
376       * as one query parameter; omitted from the wire when unset or <jk>false</jk>.
377       *
378       * <p>
379       * Without it a Review step opens <b>empty</b> and loses everything the operator typed.  With it, the
380       * runtime serializes the parent's collected form values, URL-encodes them, and appends them as a single
381       * {@code juneauDrafts} parameter, refusing visibly (and not opening the child) above a client-side byte cap
382       * measured on the <i>encoded</i> value.
383       *
384       * <p>
385       * <b>Drafts land in access logs and browser history.</b>  No secret may ride this channel.
386       */
387      public Boolean carryDrafts;
388
389      /**
390       * Creates a child action.
391       *
392       * @param id The action id a {@code type="action"} input names.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
393       * @param label The button label.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
394       * @return A new {@link ChildAction}.
395       * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code id} or {@code label} is <jk>null</jk> or blank.
396       */
397      public static ChildAction of(String id, String label) {
398         if (ib(id))
399            throw iaex("ModalDef.ChildAction id must not be null or blank.");
400         if (ib(label))
401            throw iaex("ModalDef.ChildAction label must not be null or blank.");
402         var c = new ChildAction();
403         c.id = id;
404         c.label = label;
405         return c;
406      }
407
408      /**
409       * Sets the child dialog's read-only form-source URL.
410       *
411       * @param value The URL.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset (a confirm-only child).
412       * @return This object.
413       */
414      public ChildAction form(String value) {
415         form = value;
416         return this;
417      }
418
419      /**
420       * Sets the child's submit endpoint.
421       *
422       * <p>
423       * Optional individually; a child action whose dialog is meant to be <b>submittable</b> must declare both a
424       * non-safe {@link #method} and an {@code endpoint}, or its Confirm visibly refuses with {@code safe-method}
425       * and sends nothing.  A display-only child that never submits needs neither, which is why this is not a
426       * {@link ModalDef#validate()} rule &mdash; this bean cannot know which of its children are meant to submit.
427       *
428       * @param value The endpoint.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset.
429       * @return This object.
430       */
431      public ChildAction endpoint(String value) {
432         endpoint = value;
433         return this;
434      }
435
436      /**
437       * Sets the child's submit method.
438       *
439       * <p>
440       * Optional individually; see {@link #endpoint(String)} &mdash; a submittable child needs both, and a
441       * missing or safe method is a visible client-side refusal before any request is sent.
442       *
443       * @param value The method.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset.
444       * @return This object.
445       */
446      public ChildAction method(String value) {
447         method = value;
448         return this;
449      }
450
451      /**
452       * Sets the child's on-success behaviour token.
453       *
454       * @param value The token.  Can be <jk>null</jk> to unset.
455       * @return This object.
456       */
457      public ChildAction onSuccess(String value) {
458         onSuccess = value;
459         return this;
460      }
461
462      /**
463       * Declares that opening this child carries the parent dialog's drafts (see {@link #carryDrafts}).
464       *
465       * <p>
466       * Passing <jk>false</jk> <b>clears</b> the flag rather than serializing an explicit {@code false}, so an
467       * un-opted-in child's payload is byte-identical to one that never mentioned it.
468       *
469       * @param value <jk>true</jk> to carry the parent's drafts; <jk>false</jk> (or unset) to open empty.
470       * @return This object.
471       */
472      public ChildAction carryDrafts(boolean value) {
473         carryDrafts = value ? Boolean.TRUE : null;
474         return this;
475      }
476   }
477
478   /**
479    * The frozen modal contract version discriminator.
480    *
481    * <p>
482    * Defaults to {@link #CONTRACT_VERSION} on <b>every</b> modal, confirm-only or form-bearing, from the instant
483    * it is constructed &mdash; the guarantee does not depend on {@link #checked()} being called.
484    * Guaranteed <b>present</b> is not the same as guaranteed <b>valid</b>: presence is this field's whole job,
485    * structural well-formedness is {@link #validate()}'s (see {@link #checked()}).
486    */
487   public String contractVersion = CONTRACT_VERSION;
488
489   /** The modal title / confirmation prompt. */
490   public String title;
491
492   /** The typed confirmation fields, in display order; omitted from the wire when none are declared. */
493   public List<Field> fields;
494
495   /** The optional input form; omitted from the wire when unset (a confirm-only modal). */
496   public FormDef form;
497
498   /**
499    * The server-minted idempotency key value the runtime carries on the submit; omitted from the wire when unset.
500    * The value is minted (and its {@code (action, targetId)} binding re-checked on submit) by the rich-view
501    * module's idempotency-key helper.
502    */
503   public String idempotencyKey;
504
505   /**
506    * Whether {@link #idempotencyKey} is a <b>self-targeted</b> key whose own value the runtime must send as the
507    * submitted target (see the class Javadoc); omitted from the wire when unset or <jk>false</jk>.
508    *
509    * <p>
510    * Additive-only: like {@link #barSlot}, its presence does not bump {@link #CONTRACT_VERSION}.
511    */
512   public Boolean selfTargeted;
513
514   /**
515    * Optional additive bar slot anchored to this dialog's title &mdash; the <i>third</i> named {@link BarSlot}
516    * attachment (see the class Javadoc for how this host differs from the other two).  Omitted from the wire when
517    * unset; painted by the runtime immediately after {@link #title}, ahead of {@link #fields} and {@link #form}.
518    */
519   public BarSlot barSlot;
520
521   /**
522    * Whether the runtime must <b>not</b> close this dialog at confirm-click time, so the write's result can be

564   /**

570    */
571   public static ModalDef create(String title) {

734   /**
735    * Fail-closed bean validation.
736    *
737    * <p>
738    * Requires a non-blank {@link #title} and a non-blank label on each {@link Field}; when a {@link #form} is present
739    * it delegates to {@link FormDef#validate()}.  Does <b>not</b> require {@link #contractVersion} to be set to
740    * {@link #CONTRACT_VERSION} (or set at all) &mdash; a modal whose version was explicitly cleared, or that
741    * arrived from a foreign producer that never set one, must not false-refuse on that alone.  Version-presence
742    * and structural well-formedness are deliberately independent properties (design note, &sect;5.4).
743    *
744    * <p>
745    * Also rejects, fail-closed at serve time rather than silently on the wire: a {@link Field#kind} outside the
746    * {@link #FIELD_KIND_TEXT text}/{@link #FIELD_KIND_CODE code} allowlist; a {@link #nav} other than
747    * {@link #NAV_PILL}/{@link #NAV_FOLDER}; a blank, duplicate or unlabelled
748    * {@link ChildAction} id; {@link ChildAction#carryDrafts} on a modal that declares no {@link #form} (nothing to
749    * collect <i>from</i>); and {@link ChildAction#carryDrafts} on a child that declares no
750    * {@link ChildAction#form} (nowhere to put them &mdash; the runtime would take its confirm-only branch, issue
751    * no GET, and the drafts would vanish silently).
752    *
753    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If this modal is not well-formed.
754    */
755   /** The message for a token that is neither of its two allowed values. */
756   private static String notOneOf(String what, String a, String b, String actual) {
757      return what + " must be '" + a + "' or '" + b + "', not '" + actual + "'.";
758   }
759
760   @Override
761   public void validate() {
762      if (ib(title))
763         throw iaex("ModalDef title must not be null or blank.");
764      if (fields != null)
765         for (var f : fields) {
766            if (f == null)
767               throw iaex("ModalDef field must not be null.");
768            if (f.label == null || f.label.isBlank())
769               throw iaex("ModalDef.Field label must not be null or blank.");
770            if (f.kind != null && ! (eqa(f.kind, FIELD_KIND_TEXT, FIELD_KIND_CODE)))
771               throw iaex(notOneOf("ModalDef.Field kind", FIELD_KIND_TEXT, FIELD_KIND_CODE, f.kind));
772         }
773      validateChildActions();
774      validateSteps();
775      if (chrome != null && chrome.isBlank())
776         throw iaex("ModalDef chrome must not be blank.");
777      if (nav != null && ! (eqa(nav, NAV_PILL, NAV_FOLDER)))
778         throw iaex(notOneOf("ModalDef nav", NAV_PILL, NAV_FOLDER, nav));
779      if (form != null)
780         form.validate();
781      if (barSlot != null)
782         barSlot.validate();
783   }
784
785   /** The {@link #steps} half of {@link #validate()}: non-blank unique ids and well-formed display fields. */
786   private void validateSteps() {
787      if (steps == null)
788         return;
789      var seen = new HashSet<String>();
790      for (var st : steps) {
791         if (st == null)
792            throw iaex("ModalDef.Step must not be null.");
793         if (st.id == null || st.id.isBlank())
794            throw iaex("ModalDef.Step id must not be null or blank.");
795         if (! seen.add(st.id))
796            throw iaex("ModalDef.Step id '" + st.id + "' is declared more than once on this modal.");
797         if (st.fields != null)
798            for (var f : st.fields) {
799               if (f == null || f.label == null || f.label.isBlank())
800                  throw iaex("ModalDef.Step '" + st.id + "' field label must not be null or blank.");
801               if (f.kind != null && ! (eqa(f.kind, FIELD_KIND_TEXT, FIELD_KIND_CODE)))
802                  throw iaex(notOneOf("ModalDef.Step '" + st.id + "' field kind", FIELD_KIND_TEXT, FIELD_KIND_CODE, f.kind));
803            }
804      }
805   }
806
807   /**
808    * The {@link #childActions} half of {@link #validate()}.
809    *
810    * <p>
811    * {@link ChildAction#of(String,String)} already argument-checks {@code id} and {@code label}; they are
812    * re-checked here as the wire-level backstop for a bean-deserialized instance that never went through the
813    * factory.
814    */
815   private void validateChildActions() {
816      if (childActions == null)
817         return;
818      var seen = new HashSet<String>();
819      for (var c : childActions) {
820         if (c == null)
821            throw iaex("ModalDef.ChildAction must not be null.");
822         if (c.id == null || c.id.isBlank())
823            throw iaex("ModalDef.ChildAction id must not be null or blank.");
824         if (c.label == null || c.label.isBlank())
825            throw iaex("ModalDef.ChildAction label must not be null or blank.");
826         if (! seen.add(c.id))
827            throw iaex("ModalDef.ChildAction id '" + c.id + "' is declared more than once on this modal.");
828         if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(c.carryDrafts)) {
829            if (form == null)
830               throw iaex("ModalDef.ChildAction '" + c.id + "' declares carryDrafts, but this modal declares "
831                  + "no form - there is nothing to collect drafts from.");
832            if (c.form == null || c.form.isBlank())
833               throw iaex("ModalDef.ChildAction '" + c.id + "' declares carryDrafts, but declares no form URL "
834                  + "- a confirm-only child issues no form GET, so the drafts would be dropped silently.");
835         }
836      }
837   }
838
839   /**
840    * The serving-path hook every app {@code @RestGet} that returns a {@link ModalDef} should invoke.
841    *
842    * <p>
843    * {@link #contractVersion} is guaranteed present on every modal from construction, so this is <b>no longer
844    * required for versioning</b>.  It stays <b>strongly recommended</b> for one remaining duty and
845    * is <b>redundant-but-harmless</b> for another:
846    * <ul>
847    *    <li><b>Non-REST producers</b> (a direct {@code Json.of(...)} serialization, or any consumer marshalling a
848    *       modal outside a REST response) have no other gate: calling this is the only fail-closed structural
849    *       {@link #validate() validation} they get, and skipping it means a malformed modal/form serializes as
850    *       contract-<i>valid</i> with no complaint.
851    *    <li><b>REST responses</b> are validated independently:
852    *       {@link WidgetsMixin.WidgetValidationProcessor
853    *       WidgetsMixin.WidgetValidationProcessor} calls {@link #validate()} on every REST response that is a
854    *       {@code Widget}, fail-closed with a 500, whether or not the producing endpoint called this method.
855    *       Calling it anyway is safe (validation is idempotent) and remains the only gate for the non-REST case
856    *       above.
857    * </ul>
858    * When a {@link #form} is present it also re-stamps {@link #CONTRACT_VERSION} on the form and recurses into
859    * {@link FormDef#checked()}.
860    *
861    * @return This object.
862    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If this modal (or its form) is not well-formed.
863    */
864   public ModalDef checked() {
865      if (form != null) {
866         contractVersion = CONTRACT_VERSION;
867         form.checked();
868      }
869      validate();
870      return this;
871   }
872}
